# Poly Haven assets

Downloaded from the Poly Haven public asset library on 2026-07-16 via its asset API.
Poly Haven assets are released under CC0. Source: https://polyhaven.com/license

Imported model set:

- `hand_truck_1k.fbx` — material cart / hand truck
- `ladder_sectioned_01_1k.fbx` — access ladder
- `cement_bag_1k.fbx` — construction material
- `Drill_01_1k.fbx` — power tool
- `Barrel_01_1k.fbx` — downloaded model placeholder for future site dressing

Additional real-prop replacements:

- `old_military_crate_1k.fbx` - construction material crates
- `plastic_crate_02_1k.fbx` - warehouse and exit-route cargo
- `cardboard_box_01_1k.fbx` - warehouse and fire-response obstructions
- `metal_toolbox_1k.fbx` - PPE/tool kit
- `industrial_storage_cart_1k.fbx` - warehouse/construction cart
- `concrete_road_barrier_1k.fbx` - construction exclusion barrier
- `clipboard_1k.fbx` - final inspection tool
- `korean_fire_extinguisher_01_1k.fbx` - fire-response equipment

Diffuse textures are included under `Textures/` and `Models/textures/`. These assets are used as third-party realism references and scene dressing; authored safety logic remains in the project scripts.

Environment replacement set under `Environment/`:

- Construction Yard 1K HDRI for the outdoor background and reflections
- Asphalt, damaged concrete, concrete block, concrete panel, and corrugated metal PBR textures
- Modular factory facade, chain-link fence, roller shutter, industrial pipes, generator, overhead crane, caged work light, and utility cabinet FBX models
